description: Na₂Mo₃Te₃O₁₆ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (2.32 Å) and two longer (2.80 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent MoO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 44-70°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.54 Å. There are two inequivalent Mo sites. In the first Mo site, Mo is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted MoO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 44-70°. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.75-2.25 Å. In the second Mo site, Mo is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.77-2.25 Å. There are two inequivalent Te sites. In the first Te site, Te is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (1.94 Å) and two longer (2.08 Å) Te-O bond lengths. In the second Te site, Te is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Te-O bond distances ranging from 1.88-2.65 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two Mo atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one Mo atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Mo atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Mo and one Te atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mo, and one Te atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Mo and one Te atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two Te atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one Mo, and one Te atom.
